metadata.description: Plugins for git and project workflows, code audits and release checks. All 15 run in Claude Code, and 9 also run in Codex and Cursor.

plugins.name: ai-ado
plugins.description: Sets up an Azure DevOps project and its MCP server, creates Features, User Stories and Tasks, logs hours to stories, and builds weekly timesheet reports

plugins.name: ai-accessibility
plugins.description: Audits code or a live URL for Section 508/WCAG 2.0, WCAG 2.1 or WCAG 2.2 issues, with visual checks through Playwright MCP when it's set up, and saves a report with fixes. Takes its settings as arguments for unattended runs

plugins.name: ai-git
plugins.description: Generates .gitignore files, runs typecheck, lint, format, security and test checks before you commit, and commits, pushes and opens a PR with a message in your repo's style

plugins.name: ai-performance
plugins.description: Audits a codebase, or one directory, for performance bottlenecks and saves a timestamped report with an impact score for each finding, and measures where a repository's GitHub Actions time goes, with the file, line and seconds saved for each fix

plugins.name: ai-security
plugins.description: Audits a repository for security problems and saves Markdown and JSON reports that track findings across audits, plans a sandboxed audit on a stronger model that proves each finding with a failing test, scans a live site's dependencies, and sets up file-access deny rules for secrets and pnpm supply-chain hardening

plugins.name: ai-workflow
plugins.description: Takes a branch to production through Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Bugbot review, merge and a watched deploy, or stops when the PR is ready to merge. Also runs review loops with models from several providers, finishes other people's PRs and refreshes stale ones

plugins.name: ai-statusline
plugins.description: Builds on Claude Code's native /statusline with a context progress bar, 5h/7d rate limits, a month-to-date spend budget for Enterprise/API seats without rate limits, the reasoning-effort level, a sandbox indicator, cost and duration, and a wizard to change any of it

plugins.name: ai-rules
plugins.description: Adds, upgrades and removes versioned sections of standing instructions in CLAUDE.md through a wizard: reply format, plain wording, messages to other people, PR and commit hygiene, estimates, personal data, Claude in Chrome and iOS simulators. You pick the sections, modules and settings, and upgrades merge new versions into sections you edited. Also audits your CLAUDE.md files, going further than /doctor prompt-audit, for rules that restate Claude Code's own behavior, belong in a setting or hook, sit in the wrong file, or cost context for little gain, and cleans up their structure

plugins.name: ai-modernize
plugins.description: Finds technical debt and anti-patterns in code written with older AI models or vibe coding, and saves a scored report with a prioritized roadmap. Takes its settings as arguments, and --defaults skips the setup questions for quick or unattended runs

plugins.name: ai-compliance
plugins.description: Audits the licenses of your open-source dependencies, flags copyleft and missing-license risks, and generates NOTICE or ATTRIBUTION files

plugins.name: ai-knowledge
plugins.description: Keeps a team knowledge base in git as Claude Code rules, so each article loads when Claude works on matching files, every session, or on demand from a short index. Capture learnings as you work with auto-capture or on request, add docs, repos and URLs, query and prune it, and migrate a 1.x knowledge base

plugins.name: ai-seo
plugins.description: Audits a site's code for search rankings (SEO), direct answers in featured snippets and voice assistants (AEO), and citations in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews (GEO), crawls the live site to check what search engines get, and submits new pages to Google, Bing and Brave for indexing. Catches SEO patterns LLMs still generate, applies framework-specific fixes, generates and validates JSON-LD, builds FAQ sections and question maps, and writes llms.txt

plugins.name: ai-swift
plugins.description: Catches Xcode Cloud and TestFlight blockers before upload (XcodeGen pbxproj drift, static build numbers, missing ci_scripts, macOS App Store entitlements/Info.plist, headless-CI keychain test failures, ad-hoc signing entitlement rejections, flaky-UITest release gating), diagnoses ITMS rejection emails and red CI logs, scaffolds Xcode Cloud CI, runs a local verify gate, and reviews Swift 6 strict-concurrency and SwiftUI code

plugins.name: ai-slop
plugins.description: Audits a codebase's user-facing copy, layouts and metadata for AI-written tells and factual errors, such as a privacy policy that misses the trackers the code loads, reviews a web, iOS or Android screen for AI-generated design and fixes it in ordered passes once you approve a direction, rewrites a file or pasted text to remove AI writing patterns, prunes code comments that narrate the code or excuse a workaround, and rebuilds a feature an agent just wrote as a simpler second version, keeping the first until you choose

plugins.name: ai-improve
plugins.description: Audits a codebase across nine categories and writes self-contained implementation plans that another agent or a cheaper model can carry out, each with exact files, steps that end in a check, scope limits and STOP conditions. It also writes a plan from a description or from another audit's report, hands a plan to an executor in a separate git worktree and reviews the result, and keeps the plans up to date as the code changes. It never changes source code itself
